|translation='''Title:''' Vader's Lightsaber.

'''Card text:''' Deploy only on Vader at no cost. You may add 1 to the Force drain where this card is. You may fire at one character at no cost. Draw destiny twice. If total destiny exceeds the character's ability, it is hit and its forfeit can be reduced to 0.

'''Lore:''' Built by Darth Vader. After the Clone Wars he used it to hunt Jedi. It can cut anything except another lightsaber blade.
|notes='''Vader's Lightsaber (Japanese Reflections III Foil)''' is a Japanese-language foil printing of [[Vader's Lightsaber|Vader's Lightsaber]]. [[Decipher]] released it in [[Reflections III: A Collector's Bounty]] in October 2001. The ordinary Japanese expansion printing is [[Vader's Lightsaber (Japanese)]]. Complete Card List v4 lists checklist R50 at rarity VR. Collector R-numbers are checklist references, not GEMP blueprint IDs.<ref name="checklist">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/swccgcardlist4.0.pdf Star Wars Customizable Card Game Complete Card List v4.0], p. 31, Reflections III foil cards, R50.
